references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight!
I am a voice crying out in the wilderness: Make the Lord's path straight, as the prophet Isaiah said.
As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: See, I send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way.
In those days John the Baptist came and preached in the wilderness of Judea
There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
He said: I am a voice crying out in the wilderness: Make the Lord's path straight, as the prophet Isaiah said.
